name: audit
description: Repository-specific check that every skill sits directly under kit/skills/, carries its `hoc-` prefix, and declares a `name:` equal to its own folder name, and that both skill catalogs carry a row for every one of them and a row for nothing else — the layout rules the build aborts on plus the catalogs, reported all at once with a non-zero exit for CI. Use before committing a new, renamed or moved skill. It reports only; it renames and moves nothing, it checks no frontmatter field other than `name:`, and it reads nothing of a sibling library.
